title: Cache-pruning test takes the summary cache under StateInner, against the projector lock order
outcome: The deferred-snapshot cache-pruning test inspects the session summary cache only after its StateInner and projection-cache guards are released, matching the production lock order.
acceptance: The cache-pruning test in src/tests/deferred_state_snapshot.rs clones the session summary projector handle in a scope that releases StateInner and the projection-cache guard, then locks the summary cache, so no test takes the summary cache under StateInner.
The test still checks that the cache is empty after the hidden or removed sessions are projected out.
